title: Complete the ColecoVision title-source review and rotate fresh platform searches
summary: Reviewed the final four title directories in tony-cruise/colecovision-games-source, promoted four compilable Z80 disassemblies, completed the 24-title queue task, and screened fresh Atari 8-bit, Apple II, MSX, TI-99 and BBC Micro repository searches against existing catalogue state.
notes: The CPU audit queue returned zero unresolved source/target CPU areas. Fresh-search results were either already tracked/reviewed or empty; no duplicate project records were created. No minimum runtime hardware was inferred from the ColecoVision platform.

sources.reason: Fresh-search slice; exact query `Atari 8-bit source reconstruction` returned no repositories in the reviewed result page.

Fresh-search slice; exact query `Apple II decompiler` returned moralrecordings/applesoft-basic-decompiler and stjeanp/applesoft-basic-decompiler. Both canonical URLs already resolve through the catalogue and reviewed duplicate/lineage decisions, so they were not re-reviewed or promoted again.

Fresh-search slice; exact query `MSX disassembly` returned Booga-Boo, Pyramid Warp, Arkanoid, Elite, Antarctic Adventure, Road Fighter, Stardust, Topo Soft Logo, Youkai Yashiki, Ale Hop, Temptations, Demonia, Colt 36 and Sky Jaguar repositories. Every canonical URL was already represented by a project or reviewed source/decision; no material changed source was found and no duplicate was added.
Fresh-search slice; exact query `TI-99 disassembly` returned no repositories in the reviewed result page.
Fresh-search verification; exact query `"BBC Micro" source reconstruction` returned no repositories in the reviewed result page.

source_updates.reason: All 24 titled game directories now have title-level primary-source reviews. Space Panic, Squish-em Featuring Sam, Star Wars Arcade and The Heist were the final four and were promoted as separate compilable Z80 disassemblies. The repository remains a useful watched collection for newly appearing titles.

task_updates.notes_append: Reviewed the final four directories on 2026-10-25 and promoted Space Panic, Squish-em Featuring Sam, Star Wars Arcade and The Heist. All 24 titled directories now have separate title-level reviews.

decisions.title: Space Panic — ColecoVision compilable disassembly
decisions.reason: The title README explicitly calls the work a compilable disassembly, while the assembly header identifies Captain Cozmos's resolved-link reconstruction and selects Z80 ROM output. A title-scoped record preserves the independent work inside the 24-game collection.

decisions.title: Squish-em Featuring Sam — ColecoVision compilable disassembly
decisions.reason: The title README explicitly calls the work a compilable disassembly and the source identifies Captain Cozmos's Z80 ROM reconstruction. It is independently titled and scoped within the collection.

decisions.title: Star Wars Arcade — ColecoVision compilable disassembly
decisions.reason: The title README explicitly calls this a compilable disassembly by Kamshaft and Claude Code; the annotated Z80 source documents the 16 KB ColecoVision ROM, VDP, sound and reconstruction structure. AI attribution is scoped to this title only.

decisions.title: The Heist — ColecoVision compilable disassembly

identity.narrative: The title README and assembly header identify Space Panic as a distinct reconstruction by Captain Cozmos inside the shared game-source repository.

classification.narrative: The README calls it a compilable disassembly and the annotated source reconstructs the ColecoVision game ROM; it is not presented as original homebrew.

source_cpu.narrative: The assembly source explicitly selects CPU Z80 for the original ColecoVision program.

target_cpu.narrative: The same Z80 assembly source emits the reconstructed ColecoVision ROM.

build.narrative: The README calls the listing compilable and the source contains an explicit ROM output directive.
build.limitations: This pass did not run the assembler, execute the ROM or perform a byte comparison. The author's 'same code' statement was not treated as an independently established byte-exact build.

runtime_profiles.narrative: README and source header were checked; they discuss emulator-specific behavior but state no separate minimum CPU, RAM, chipset or ROM requirement.

ai.narrative: The inspected README and assembly header contain no development-AI attribution; absence does not establish non-use.

relationships.narrative: Space Panic is one separately titled directory in the 24-game collection and is retained as an independent subject record; the shared repository does not collapse the title-level work into one game.
